children: Overview
Canada oil and gas producer's Q3 adjusted funds flow rose year-over-year
Q3 production averaged 20,000 Boe/d, down slightly from last year
Company reduced net debt and secured new credit facility for future drilling
Outlook
Company has 37% of Q4 2026 natural gas production hedged at C$3.11/Mcf
Company has 55% of Q4 2026 crude oil production hedged at US$69.23/Bbl
Company expanding Q4 2026 development with two Glauconite wells and one Pekisko oil well
Result Drivers
HEDGING STRATEGY - Co said realized natural gas prices were supported by hedging and market diversification, resulting in a premium to benchmark prices
DRILLING ACTIVITY - Q3 capital spending included drilling costs for new Glauconite wells
